{{Quote|Anyone been following local politics in this sector?''"<br />"''I have, a little. My father-in-law's got some interests here. Ten to one it's the Frezhlix; they've been feuding with the Sif'kries ever since we chased the Empire out of the area.|[[Rogue Twelve]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The '''Mezeg sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mezeg]] was located in the sector.

==History==
{{Quote|The Sif'krie government cast the deciding vote that prevented our sector's Senator from adding his voice to the growing condemnation of the Bothan government and people.|[[Plarx]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
[[Booster Terrik]] had some interest in the sector during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the sector supported the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] at the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]].<ref name="SotP" />
